info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Payments Payments Void-v3-spec
info.description: The Void Payments API enables businesses to efficiently cancel or void previously processed payment transactions. This functionality is essential for scenarios where payments need to be reversed due to errors or customer requests. It allows for seamless management of payment statuses and ensures accurate financial reporting. Typically used by financial institutions, payment processors, and e-commerce platforms, this API facilitates quick and reliable transaction management, ultimately enhancing customer satisfaction.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to void a payment transaction, ensuring that the funds are not captured or processed. Use this operation when you need to cancel a payment that has not yet been finalized.

requestBody.description: Request body for the void payment operation. This body should contain the necessary information to identify the payment that needs to be voided.

200.description: The payment void operation was successful.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the DELETE operation to void a payment.

status.description: Indicates the success or failure of the void operation.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the payment transaction.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the void operation.

state.description: The current state of the void operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the void operation, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the void operation.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidResponse_200.description: Response schema for the void operation DELETE request.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user who created the void operation.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the void operation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Information related to the audit of the void operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This value helps in understanding the performance impact of the operation.
